milestones.title: Study tube wells as backup water sources
milestones.description: Abdul Rahman reported that PETRA and NAHRIM were studying tube-well development for resilience during water-supply disruption.
milestones.progress_note: In progress describes the study reported in May. The evidence does not confirm a completed national study, operational wells or a November construction measurement.

milestones.title: Advance pre-implementation work for the Sungai Air Salak flood scheme
milestones.description: Abdul Rahman reported approval under the second rolling plan of RMK13 and planning for consultants, surveys and land acquisition.
milestones.progress_note: Pre-implementation is reported, with consultant appointment expected in mid-2027. No completed land acquisition, physical-completion percentage or finished flood protection is established.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise.
